resources.string: Lock when the screen turns off
Biometric unlock works for this long after you type the master password. It is also asked after the phone restarts.
Where your account is open. Sign out a device you do not recognize, or one you lost: it stops at once and removes your data the next time it starts.
It loses access to your account at once, and removes the account\'s data it keeps the next time it runs.
A new device is asking to sign in to your account.
A new device wants to sign in
Someone is trying to sign in to your Keyless account on a new device. If it is you, continue and type the code that device shows. Otherwise, deny.
Never approve a device you are not holding, even if someone asks you to.
Waiting for the new device to show its code…
Type the 6-digit code shown on the new device.
Approved. The new device still needs your master password.
This device was signed out from another of your devices, and the account\'s data on it was removed.
The list of devices is not available on the server yet.
That is not the code the new device shows. Check it and try again.
Too many wrong codes: the request was refused.
The request could not be checked.
Sign in to Keyless with a passkey instead of your master password and Secret Key. The passkey must support the PRF extension (Google Password Manager and most security keys do).
Passkeys are removed when the master password or the Secret Key changes.
This passkey cannot be used to sign in to Keyless (it does not support the PRF extension).
This passkey is not set up for Keyless, or was removed.
Too many attempts with this passkey. Try again later.
Signing in with a passkey is not turned on yet.
Unlock with your master password (not biometrics) to add a passkey.
